config.section.detective.label: Detective
config.section.detective.desc: Lets the agent research a topic and cite the sources it used.
config.detective.extra_read_help: Adds exact tool operations that research may call on connected private services. A case still has to select the source.
config.detective.extra_read_format: One line per tool: tool: operation, operation
config.detective.restart: Restart AuraGo after changing effort profiles. Existing runs keep their accepted budgets.
config.detective.help_enabled: Turns on research with traceable sources. A case only uses sources you explicitly select.
config.detective.help_readonly: Allows research to read only. Recommended unless you are sure nothing may be changed.
config.detective.help_seconds: Longest run time of one job in seconds (30 to 7200), after which it is stopped.
config.detective.help_tools: Maximum number of tool calls per job (1 to 500).
config.detective.help_iterations: Maximum number of reasoning and work rounds per job (1 to 750).
config.detective.help_tokens: Additional cap on tokens used per job. 0 = no additional limit.
